properties.summary: GDELT read 13 news articles whose headlines name Delta Air Lines with an outage word, from 13 outlets (abc7ny.com, aol.co.uk, cedarnews.net, dailymail.com, express.co.uk, fox23maine.com, fox4beaumont.com, nypost.com and 5 more), in the 6 hours to 18:00 UTC 22 Nov 2026, against a usual of 0 for that many hours over the 7 days before. The first came in GDELT's file of 14:45 UTC 22 Nov 2026. The usual rests on 623 of the 672 files of the 7 days before, the rest not yet read. Public Bluesky posts also surged (105; see that item). Reported by the press and not confirmed by Delta Air Lines; Blackout links the articles and does not reproduce their headlines. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).
